description: What a script contains: its structure from the file, or symbols, completions and hover text from the editor's language server. It reads .gd files only, and answers what a script uses rather than what uses it: project_search finds where a class, a member or a signal is named. symbols, completion and hover name under unseenByEditor each class the project declares that the editor cannot see yet, with unseenNote: the language server reads such a class as nothing, so a completion after self. in a script extending one comes back empty. editor_rescan brings it in. Operations: structure: functions (each parameter's default the source text after its =, so = null reads "null", and null for a parameter with none), variables (static ones marked is_static; one written with := has the type of a literal or built-in constructor it is given, marked inferred, as a constant always does), signals, constants, enums, inner_classes (each with its name, line and extends, and its own members in these same fields), class_name, extends and line_count, read from the file, and dependencies: the paths it loads or preloads as written, then the scripts declaring each project class_name its code uses, which classes_used names with the class; autoloads_used names each autoload the code uses by its global name, with the autoload's script, which the project loads rather than this script, so it is not under dependencies. A member or inner class with a ## documentation comment directly above it carries the comment's text as doc, and the script's own, the ## block above class_name or extends or one followed by a blank line before any member, comes back as class_doc; symbols: document symbols from the language server, each with its kind, the line and column of its name, and the lastLine of its declaration; completion (needs line, character): completions at a position, narrowed to the part of a name written before it, at most 100; hover (needs line, character): hover text at a position. Default structure.

character.description: completion, hover: the column, counted from 1 as the editor shows it, with a tab counted as one. symbols gives each name at the line and column hover is asked at. Only for ops completion, hover.

includeInherited.description: structure: also list what the script inherits, walking extends through the project's other scripts. Each such member carries inherited_from, the file declaring it, and the answer gains inherits_from, the chain that was walked. A name the script overrides is listed at both its lines rather than once. A native base is not walked, since it declares nothing in a file: editor_classes info answers for those. Default false. Only for op structure.

line.description: completion, hover: the line, counted from 1 as the editor shows it. Only for ops completion, hover.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

scriptPath.description: Script file inside the project, such as "scripts/player.gd".

name: script_info
title: Script info
